gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8481 covers taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances and parts thereof; Section XVII note 2(f) excludes articles of Section XVI (including 8481 machines/parts) from Section XVII, so vehicle brake-part headings 8708 do not apply; Section XVI note 2(a) sends parts of 8481 goods to 8481
GRI 6: 8481.90 parts; 8481.90.90 other; .85 other (not valve bodies, not steel forgings)

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of vehicle brakes; Section XVII note 2(f) excludes parts of heading 8481 goods
valve bodies of 8481.20 valves; no information on part type
material lines for other valve types; material not stated

missing_facts: Which part (valve body, plunger, coil, forging) and its material; only affects the 8 or 10-digit line
classification.rationale: Parts of solenoid valves are parts of heading 8481 goods even when destined for a brake system. J89209 (solenoid valves, 8481.80.9005) confirms solenoid valves are 8481, but concerns complete valves, not parts. Statistical suffix assumed.
